messages:
maddie: hi all, first day! accepted the org invite but when i try `git push origin feature/maddie-ux` i get: remote: Permission to redwood/redwood-web.git denied to maddie-personal. fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/redwood-web/': The requested URL returned error: 403. who should i ping to fix this?

infra-bot: Reminder: org requires SSO and approved team membership for repo write access. Check https://handbook.redwood.com/onboarding/github. If you haven't authorized SSO, you may be a member but not authorized for teams.

maddie: i authorized SSO earlier. web UI shows me as a member, but the repo teams list says my membership is pending. i confirmed `git config --get user.email` -> maddie.personal@gmail.com and my GitHub account with the ssh key is maddie-personal.

ops-ella: likely a second account problem. two common paths: 1) merge the accounts via GH support, or 2) we re-invite the account that owns your SSH key. which account did you accept the invite with (work email or personal)?

maddie: i accepted using maddie@redwood.com but my laptop SSH key is registered on maddie-personal. i can move the key but worried about breaking my personal setup.

kevin: temporary safe route: push to your fork and open a PR. `git remote add fork git@github.com:maddie-personal/redwood-web.git` then `git push fork feature/maddie-ux`. that avoids blocking your day while we sort identitiy.

maddie: ok pushed to fork and opened draft PR #47. thanks.

ops-ella: i'll add a note on your onboarding ticket. @infra-bot can reissue an invite to the maddie-personal account or change mapping to the SSO-authorized account. which do you prefer?

maddie: i'd prefer the latter (re-invite personal) so i don't have to migrate keys immediately. i can register a separate key for work later. also — do we allow the same YubiKey on personal and work accounts? i hooked one to my personal last year.

hr-lucas: security policy: do not reuse personal security tokens for company accounts. request a company key via ops and register a new 2FA method for the work account. we can expedite shipping if needed.

ops-ella: noted. @maddie i just resent the invite to your maddie-personal GitHub account and flagged it to require SSO. accept it and then check Teams -> Membership. i'll then add you to the 'web' team with write perms.

maddie: received and accepted invite, membership shows active now. tried `git push origin feature/maddie-ux` and it succeeded. you all rock, thanks :tada:

kevin: welcome aboard! feel free to ping me for frontend reviews.

infra-bot: onboarding checklist updated: maddie -> repo access, 2FA pending company key. ops ticket #4532 created for yubikey shipment.
